description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 27.06.2022 to 03.07.2022
categorisation: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges, which constitutes a regulatory matter under the Customs Ordinance. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it establishes compliance requirements for customs payments and formally rescinds a previous notification, making it a statutory instrument rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
